faq.question: Q1. What is the organization recruiting for Chief Scientific Officer / Project Scientist III posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment for Chief Scientific Officer / Project Scientist III posts is being conducted by the Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB).

faq.question: Q2. What are the names of the posts available in this RCB recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts available are Chief Scientific Officer and Project Scientist III (Biopharma / Biotherapeutics / Veterinary Science).

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced in the RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Chief Scientific Officer and Project Scientist III positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for the RCB Chief Scientific Officer / Project Scientist III posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for these posts is 13 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the RCB Chief Scientific Officer / Project Scientist III recruitment is online. Candidates need to visit the official website to apply.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these RCB posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 45 years (minimum) and 45 years (maximum) of age. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Chief Scientific Officer / Project Scientist III positions?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Doctoral degree in Science or a Master's degree in Engineering/Technology with significant relevant professional or R&D experience, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for the Chief Scientific Officer / Project Scientist III posts at RCB?
faq.answer: The salary for these positions ranges from Rs. 78,000 to Up to Rs. 2,00,000 per month, along with HRA for some posts, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for the RCB recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for General/OBC candidates, while SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Chief Scientific Officer / Project Scientist III posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening by a Screening Committee, followed by a further selection process as determined by the organization.
